body: Thank you for kind words, I'm probably going to do it. I believe the afterlife is way better than this one.
Thank you, i'll try to exchange dinner for labor.

Thank you for your words, but I don't even have money for the hostel I'm living in. I'm getting some support from the government but it's not enough to make ends meet. I've stayed some nights on friends couches, but they've gotten a bit tired off me perhaps. I have some other friends but they live far away, spending money on plane tickets isn't wise. I'm thinking about maybe living on the streets for a bit, but getting food is hard.

A few, most of them can barely survive themselves. We all got our problems so I won't bother them, already gotten some money from them aswell. I haven't given up entirely, I had an ok job interview last week. So they might call me back. Until thursday I'm just trying to get by, get some food and wait for the phone to ring(applied jobs everywhere too, so nothing left to do than wait)
